name: Sophia
description: Femme aux longs cheveux bruns, vêtue d'une blouse blanche et d'un stéthoscope, posant frontalement dans un couloir d'hôpital.
speechPersonality: Une voix posée et claire, avec un rythme modéré et une articulation précise, reflétant le professionnalisme et la sérénité de l'avatar. La chaleur naturelle de la voix "Kore" s'accorde parfaitement à son expression bienveillante et son rôle éducatif.

tonePrompts.neutral: A medium close-up, frontal portrait captures a woman with a neutral and composed expression, her gaze directed straight at the viewer. Her face is distinctly oval with smooth, unblemished skin, and subtle contours along her cheekbones. Her dark brown eyes are calm and steady, framed by well-defined, dark, and slightly arched eyebrows. She has no visible facial hair. Her long, straight, dark brown hair is parted in the middle and cascades over her shoulders, framing her face elegantly. She is wearing a crisp white lab coat, its collar visible and two white buttons fastened on the right side of her chest. A black stethoscope is draped around her neck, with its silver earpieces resting on her shoulders and the silver chest piece hanging prominently in the foreground. The background reveals a brightly lit hospital or clinic corridor, characterized by light beige walls and a darker floor that recedes into the distance. Overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the scene evenly. On the left side of the corridor, a white medical cart is partially visible, and on the right, a door frame adds to the institutional setting. The overall impression is one of professionalism and quiet confidence in a clean, functional environment.
